(c) Justification step: L5 Phase 5 partner reads rules and checks each other's animal-vs-number consistency, justifying the rule label. instructional_balance.justification: Strict L4 met. CRA: concrete (clap-stomp warmups, animal cards, real-life hunt) → representational (parade strips, sticky-rule labels, Core Loops) → abstract (numbers up to 100, table of values, +N/-N notation, far-term prediction without drawing). L5 explicit 4-stage cycle as separately-numbered action steps: PLAN (Phase 1) → TEST on paper (Phases 2-3 build + translate) → TABLE OF VALUES test (Phase 4) → TEST WITH MOVEMENT (Phase 5 lead) → REFINE on paper + REFLECT (Phase 6).
